messages:
maya: opened PR to refresh the Kaldera4b model card. adding long-context guidance, embedding caveats, and a tiny SDK snippet. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/802
anika: thanks! can you note the quantized behavior too? folks keep asking whether quantized==identical-output
lee: ran quick perf passes on g5.large. rough numbers: fp16 ~950 tok/s, int8 ~780 tok/s, cpu-fallback ~210 tok/s. i'll paste the run lines in a sec.
jon: please standardize examples to `context_tokens` instead of `max_tokens` across the card and migration guide
sam: looked at the PR: runtime compat link points to /docs/runtime which 404s in the preview. probable link ref got renamed last week
docs-bot: link-checker: 1 broken link detected in changed files: /docs/runtime -> 404
maya: fixed the link to /docs/runtime/compatibility and updated the SDK snippet to use `context_tokens`. also added a short callout: "quantized variants may produce small numeric differences; pin the variant for reproducible results"
lee: perf paste: ```
# quick run
model=kaldera4b
seq=1024
fp16: 950 tok/s
int8-quant: 780 tok/s
cpu-fallback: 210 tok/s
```
jon: can we convert to deltas in the card? e.g., -18% int8 vs fp16, -78% cpu vs fp16. easier for product teams to parse
anika: small wording nit: change 'cold start' to 'first-token latency' in the long-context section. it's clearer when discussing kv cache behavior
maya: updated wording and added a tiny migration snippet recommending pinning: `model: kaldera4b@v2026-03-15`
jon: i added a quick graceful-fallback snippet for the SDK: ```python
try:
  out = client.generate(model="kaldera4b:int8", prompt=p)
except InferenceUnavailableError:
  out = client.generate(model="kaldera4b", prompt=p, prefer_cpu=True)
```
sam: preview build failed earlier but i retriggered it; also pls add units to the bench table header (tok/s) and a caption
maya: added table caption and units, short note on embedding differences vs chat-embedding (kaldera4b-embed != kaldera4b-chat-embed), linked to /docs/embeddings/policy
docs-bot: deploy-preview created: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/kaldera4b-card-802. visual diff: small changes only
lee: local doc build LGTM. one last thing: add a TODO for longer-running memory and cold-cache traces so SRE can follow up
maya: added TODO and a GH issue link to track extended profiling. merging after :eyes: from docs team
anika: :eyes: looks good to me. feel free to merge.
maya: merged. :shipit:
